name: The Detail That Doesn't Fit
description:
Clara's body was positioned facing west. Every genuine Ripper victim faces east — a detail never printed in any newspaper. Edmund knows this because he set the type on every Ripper story the Chronicle ran. Whoever staged this killing had read the published accounts closely, but missed this one unreported fact.

This was not the Ripper. This was someone who wanted it to look like the Ripper.
journal_entry: It wasn't random. It was deliberate. Someone who reads the Chronicle — but not someone with access to the real investigation files.
